name: seo-audit-marketplace
description: Marketplace manifest for the SEO Audit Plugin. Install via: /plugin marketplace add <org>/<repo>

plugins.name: seo-audit
plugins.description: Engineering-grade SEO, AEO, and GEO audits for any website. Produces Markdown tickets + interactive HTML reports with before/after code, confidence scores, interactive checklists, and 0-100 scoring (SEO Quality + E-E-A-T). Site-architecture-driven: auto-detects 10 domain archetypes (Marketing, Blog, E-commerce, SaaS, Job board, Staffing services, Course platform, Documentation, Multi-product conglomerate, Personal site) and tailors audit scope accordingly.
